description: In WebKit (Safari engine) clicking into the read-only Invite text textarea does not select its contents: after the click selectionStart=selectionEnd=0 (length 723). In Chromium the same click selects 0-723. The textarea is 5 rows (clientHeight ~95-100px) for ~16 lines of content (scrollHeight 290-308px), so the pardner-invite-v1 line is out of view and a manual drag-select easily misses it.
expected: Clicking or focusing the textarea selects the whole invitation in every supported browser.
actual: Safari users get a caret, not a selection; Cmd+C copies nothing.
suggested_fix: Select on mouseup/click as well as focus (or call select() in a requestAnimationFrame after focus) and size the textarea to its content.

description: The "Add one of your devices" dialog lists every invitation of every purpose (Human rows first). Revoke buttons for Human invites sit in a dialog about devices.
expected: The list is filtered to the opened purpose, or the purpose column is emphasised with a filter.
actual: Mixed Human / My device rows in the device dialog.
suggested_fix: Filter by purpose with an "All" toggle, or move history to one "Manage invitations" view.
